title: Agentic Multi-Document Analysis System
description: Autonomous AI agent that plans, reasons, selects tools, analyzes multiple documents, compares extracted fields, detects discrepancies, and generates structured reports.
proof_points: Uses multi-step tool calling instead of single-turn chatbot logic.
Supports OCR for scanned documents.
Extracts dates, amounts, IBANs, invoice numbers, and emails.
Compares information across multiple documents.
Shows reasoning steps transparently in the UI.

title: OCR-Based RAG Assistant for German and English Documents
description: RAG + OCR pipeline for German and English document processing. Users can upload PDFs or scanned images, ask natural language questions, and receive answers with source-aware document context.
proof_points: Combines native PDF extraction with Tesseract OCR.
Uses sentence-transformer embeddings and FAISS vector search.
Supports German and English documents.
Extracts structured document fields.
Includes REST API and Streamlit frontend.

title: Music-Driven Cityscape Visualization
description: Real-time audio-reactive visualization engine that converts music features into procedural cityscape animations inspired by Passau.
proof_points: Analyzed RMS, beats, tempo, spectral centroid, and frequency bands.
Created mood-adaptive colors, particles, water ripples, and animated city elements.
Built modular architecture for visual computing seminar.

title: UXRVT: Unity XR Visualization Toolkit
description: Unity-based toolkit inspired by D3.js for immersive 3D data visualization in XR environments.
proof_points: Implemented zoom, pan, tooltips, reverse mapping, and AR object instantiation.
Designed for large structured datasets in immersive environments.

title: EEG Sleep Scoring using Ensemble Learning and CNN-LSTM
description: EEG-based sleep stage classification system using ensemble machine learning and a CNN-LSTM model.
proof_points: Built EEG preprocessing and feature extraction pipeline.
Used Random Forest, Logistic Regression, AdaBoost, and CNN-LSTM models.
Worked with PhysioNet EDFX dataset.

title: Plant Disease Detection using Transfer Learning
description: End-to-end computer vision pipeline for plant disease classification using CNNs and transfer learning.
proof_points: Compared EfficientNet-B2, ResNet152V2, VGG-19, DenseNet169, and Xception.
Classified 17 plant disease categories.
Used preprocessing, augmentation, fine-tuning, and model evaluation.
